mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_preferences p JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id WHERE u.public_id = #{publicId}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_preferences (user_id, instructions, reply_language, response_style, use_history, updated_at) SELECT u.id, #{instructions,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{replyLanguage}, #{responseStyle}, #{useHistory}, now() FROM users u WHERE u.public_id = #{publicId}::uuid ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET instructions = EXCLUDED.instructions, reply_language = EXCLUDED.reply_language, response_style = EXCLUDED.response_style, use_history = EXCLUDED.use_history, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
